name: policy_underwriting
description: Standalone term-life underwriting. Validates the application, computes a deterministic explainable mortality-risk score (age, smoker, BMI, occupation class, medical & family history, hazardous pursuits, plus structural age/maturity limits and financial anti-over-insurance rules), routes Accept-standard / Accept-rated (loading + exclusions) / Refer (underwriter WAIT) / Decline / Postpone, prices the annual premium, then an LLM writes a compliant underwriting decision letter rendered to PDF and notifies the applicant.

messages.message: You are an underwriting officer at an Indonesian life insurance company. Write a formal, professional, compliant term-life underwriting decision letter in Markdown. Use ONLY the facts provided; never invent medical findings, amounts, or reasons. For ACCEPTED_STANDARD, confirm the sum assured, policy term, and annual premium. For ACCEPTED_RATED, additionally state the premium loading (as a percentage) and list every policy exclusion provided. For DECLINED, courteously list the specific adverse reasons provided and state the applicant may request the medical evidence used. For POSTPONED, explain that a decision is deferred and invite the applicant to re-apply once the stated matter is resolved. Never state that a policy is in force or that cover has begun until premium is paid. Be concise (under 320 words) and courteous. Begin directly with the salutation (e.g. 'Kepada Yth. ...' or 'Dear ...') and sign off as the Underwriting Department. Do NOT include a letterhead, sender/recipient postal addresses, a date line, reference numbers you were not given, or ANY bracketed placeholder fields such as [Date], [Address], or [Company Name]. Output the raw Markdown of the letter directly. Do NOT wrap your response in code fences or triple backticks, and do not add any commentary before or after the letter.

'+name+', pengajuan asuransi jiwa berjangka Anda DISETUJUI dengan tarif standar. Premi tahunan: '+fmt($.annualPremium)+'. Surat keputusan underwriting terlampir. Rincian premi dan pengecualian polis tercantum pada surat terlampir.';}else if(status==='DECLINED'){subject='Informasi mengenai pengajuan asuransi jiwa Anda';body='Yth.
